description.zh:
资源共享邀请ID。

您可以调用[ListResourceShareInvitations](~~450564~~)获取资源共享邀请ID。
description.en:
The ID of the resource sharing invitation.

You can call the [ListResourceShareInvitations](~~450564~~) operation to obtain the ID of a resource sharing invitation.

descriptions.zh: 本文将提供一个示例，在`cn-hangzhou`地域，拒绝ID为`i-yyTWbkjHArYh****`的资源共享邀请。
descriptions.en: This topic provides an example on how to call the API operation to reject the resource sharing invitation `i-yyTWbkjHArYh****` in the `cn-hangzhou` region.
